Blueprint Design System

Governance for a design system hundreds of teams build on. Proposals got screened against a clear standard, the standard itself got consolidated, and the documentation got written so the rules hold without one person in the room. A team gets a standard that keeps working between reviews.

About Finni

Creative problems need creative solutions

My career path was not a straight line: research at UC San Diego, a decade leading art and UI/UX teams in games, then Facebook Avatars and Visual Systems at Meta. At every stop, the lessons I learned from my past experiences became valuable tools to understand new problems, and allowed me to bring a holistic perspective to any team. To me, knowing the context is everything. By first learning how something came to be, then we can build a system that fits.

01

Strategy

I look for context in every scenario. The product, of course. Also the teams and pipelines around it. If something needs to scale, I build that into the foundation from the start.

02

Leadership

People do their best work in spaces where they feel safe enough to really try. Much of my work is translation: helping people understand each other, and matching what each person is good at with what the work needs.

03

Product

A maker and entrepreneur at heart, trained as a scientist. I like inventive fixes for complex problems, and I test them against how products actually ship.
